name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce CRM platform with REST API, OAuth-based access, and hosted MCP servers for AI agents.
gate_detail: REST access needs a Salesforce org (Developer Edition org or dev sandbox used in quick start) plus an authorized app. Hosted MCP is intended only for Flex Credits customers. Whether a free org suffices is not stated.
api_scope: REST API for Salesforce resources; hosted MCP servers expose SObject CRUD, Apex actions, Flows, Data 360 and Tableau.

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM platform with OAuth and private app token APIs plus remote MCP server.
gate_detail: Sources do not state plan requirements for creating private apps or OAuth apps. The MCP server requires the HubSpot account admin to connect first via a user-level app. Free tools exist per homepage.
api_scope: CRM and other HubSpot APIs on api.hubapi.com via OAuth or private app tokens; remote MCP server covers CRM records, activities, content, campaigns.

name: Pipedrive
description: Pipedrive CRM with RESTful API using API tokens or OAuth 2.0, webhooks and SDKs.
gate_detail: Every plan includes an API token at no extra charge, but no free plan is stated, only a 14-day trial. Developer sandbox account can be requested. Marketplace public apps involve a listing process not detailed.
api_scope: RESTful JSON API v1/v2 covering deals, persons, organizations, leads, activities, webhooks and more; official client libraries and OpenAPI 3 specs.

name: Attio
description: Attio CRM with REST API, App SDK and MCP, authenticated by workspace access tokens.
gate_detail: Token generation is available on all plans but requires a workspace admin. Start-for-free signup exists on the site. Sandbox not described.
api_scope: REST API and App SDK for reading, creating and updating workspace data, with webhook reference docs; also an Attio MCP.

name: Twenty
description: Open-source CRM Twenty with workspace-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth and MCP.
gate_detail: Tokens are generated in a workspace's Settings, and the product can be self-hosted. Plan requirements for the hosted API are not established in excerpts; pricing page was truncated.
api_scope: Per-workspace REST and GraphQL APIs generated from the workspace schema; OpenAPI doc; twenty-sdk for apps; MCP endpoint.

name: Podio
description: Podio is a work-management platform with a full programmable API for integrations and apps.
gate_detail: Any free or paid Podio account can grab an API key from account settings; both have full API access. Some destructive operations need an increased trust level via support request. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Described as a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality, with client wrappers for PHP, .NET, Ruby, Java, Python, Android and Objective-C.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Zoho CRM is a cloud CRM platform with a public developer API and MCP servers.
gate_detail: A Zoho CRM account with appropriate user permissions is needed; a freemium edition (up to 3 users) and a free trial exist. Sources do not state whether free edition API access is limited. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Zoho CRM API (V8) over CRM resources such as Leads, Contacts and Deals, with scoped OAuth permissions for modules, settings, users and org.

name: Close
description: Close is a sales CRM with a REST API, OAuth apps, webhooks and an MCP server.
gate_detail: Developers create API keys in a Close account under Settings, Developer, API Keys, subject to role permissions (Manage own API keys). Whether a free plan or trial suffices is not stated in the sources.
api_scope: REST API with full endpoint docs, webhooks and a 30-day event log, plus OAuth app creation for integrations and an MCP server for AI agents.

name: Copper
description: Copper is a Google Workspace-oriented CRM with a RESTful Developer API.
gate_detail: API keys are self-generated by users in System settings, but need a Copper account (pricing shows free trial only). OAuth requires registering your app by contacting Copper to receive client_id and client_secret.
api_scope: RESTful JSON Developer API covering most Copper resources, with Postman collection; OAuth scope grants full read and modify access to the user's records.

name: DealCloud
description: DealCloud (Intapp) is a deal-management CRM with API docs, SDKs and an MCP section.
gate_detail: Sources show only navigation headings (Obtaining an API Key, User Groups and Permissions); who can obtain keys and on which plan is not stated.
api_scope: Documented areas include schema, data, users, files, history, publications, backups, relationship intelligence, plus Python, C# and REST client SDKs.

name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk is a customer support platform with public APIs authenticated by OAuth or API tokens.
gate_detail: Developer must be a verified user on a Zendesk account; OAuth clients are created by an admin on plans such as Suite Team and above or Support Team and above. No free tier or sandbox is stated.
api_scope: Zendesk APIs authenticated with OAuth access tokens, including OAuth client management, token creation, refresh tokens and PKCE support.

name: Intercom
description: Intercom customer messaging and support platform with a REST API and hosted MCP server.
gate_detail: Access tokens are for your own workspace; OAuth is for public apps. Sources do not say which plan or signup is needed to obtain credentials, and give no sandbox or free-tier detail.
api_scope: REST API reference (version 2.18) with US, EU and AU regional servers; covers workspace data such as conversations and contacts, plus help center articles via MCP.

name: Freshdesk
description: Freshdesk helpdesk with a documented REST API v2 using API keys.
gate_detail: Rate-limit table shows the Free plan at 0 API calls per minute, so a paid plan is needed for production use. Trials get 50 calls per minute; signup is free.
api_scope: Tickets, contacts, contact fields, agents, service accounts and API key management under /api/v2; plain JSON over HTTPS; separate app SDK.

name: Front
description: Front shared inbox and customer communication platform with REST Core API, SDKs and MCP server.
gate_detail: Only a Front company admin can create and manage API tokens. Plans are per seat (Starter $25/seat/mo) with a free trial; sources do not describe a free tier or sandbox.
api_scope: Core API for conversations, messages, drafts, contacts, templates and more, with token scopes; Plugin SDK for UI plugins.

name: Pylon
description: Pylon B2B support platform with an API token and hosted OAuth MCP server.
gate_detail: Token is generated in Pylon's workspace settings per a third-party README, implying a Pylon account is needed. Plan, pricing or approval requirements are not stated in sources; no sandbox shown.
api_scope: Pylon API described by an OpenAPI spec per a third-party wrapper; hosted MCP covers issues, accounts, contacts and knowledge base.

name: LiveAgent
description: LiveAgent helpdesk with API v3 key authentication and a built-in MCP server.
gate_detail: Account holders generate keys in Configuration > System > API. Pricing page shows paid plans with Start free trial and no free plan; MCP server is listed on the Business plan.
api_scope: API v3 (current) and deprecated v1 with a Swagger descriptor; permissions per key cover actions such as reading tickets and posting messages.

name: Plain
description: Plain customer support platform with a GraphQL API using machine user API keys.
gate_detail: Docs describe creating a machine user and API key, but sources do not state plan, signup, approval or sandbox requirements.
api_scope: GraphQL API with queries, mutations, types and webhook events, per documentation search tags.

name: Help Scout
description: Help Scout shared inbox helpdesk with Inbox API, Docs API and webhooks for developers.
gate_detail: Developer creates an OAuth2 app under Your Profile > My apps; credentials must belong to an active invited user. Docs API keys need a Docs permission granted by an Account Owner or Administrator. A Free plan exists; API availability by plan is not stated.
api_scope: Inbox API for conversations, threads, tags, users, workflows and webhooks; Docs API for articles, collections, categories and sites; Chat API and webhooks also listed.

name: Gorgias
description: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk with a REST API for tickets and account data.
gate_detail: API keys are available on all Helpdesk plans, created by the account owner or admins in Settings > REST API. Plans are paid (Starter $40/mo) with a no-credit-card free trial; public apps also need Developer Portal partnership and app review.
api_scope: REST API to read and write helpdesk data programmatically; account-scoped, acting with the permissions of the key holder's user.

name: Gladly
description: Gladly customer service platform with REST API, Lookup API, webhooks and Chat SDK.
gate_detail: A technical admin with a Gladly account must create the token in Settings, and the user needs the API User permission/role granted. No free signup or plan details are stated; it is a customer-account product.
api_scope: REST API for agents, customers, conversations, topics, tasks, inboxes, teams, reports, exports and webhooks, plus a Lookup API for serving your own data.

name: Slack
description: Slack Web API, Events API and related APIs for building apps in Slack workspaces.
gate_detail: Tokens come from OAuth with scopes set in app settings. Commercial distribution requires a separate agreement, typically Marketplace submission or a partner agreement; internal-only apps are not stated to need review. Free signup details not stated.
api_scope: Web API HTTP methods, Events API (HTTP or Socket Mode), plus Admin, SCIM and Audit Logs APIs for specific use cases.

name: Twilio
description: Twilio programmable communications REST APIs for voice, messaging and account management.
gate_detail: Developer signs up (Start for free) and creates an API key in the Console. Trial limits and paid-usage requirements for production are not detailed in the sources.
api_scope: REST APIs for accounts, phone numbers, Voice calls, Messaging SMS/MMS, usage and credentials; official SDKs available.

name: Zoho Cliq
description: Zoho Cliq team chat with REST API, bots, webhooks and an official MCP server.
gate_detail: Developer registers a client in the Zoho API Console to get Client ID and secret; Cliq offers free signup and a 15-day trial. Whether the free plan includes API use is not stated.
api_scope: REST API v2/v3 for channels, chats, messages, bots, threads, reminders, scheduled messages, slash commands and more, with OpenAPI documents.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Lark (lark-sh) realtime database platform docs; not the Larksuite open platform requested.
gate_detail: Sources describe a dashboard secret key for signing tokens but say nothing on signup, plans or approval. They also cover docs.larksh.com, not open.larksuite.com, so access for the hinted product is not established.
api_scope: Sources cover Lark SDK, Firebase SDKs, REST API and CLI navigation for a database-style platform; nothing on Larksuite messaging endpoints.

name: Pumble
description: Pumble team chat with an API addon that issues API keys for HTTP requests.
gate_detail: Addon is stated as available on all plans to Owner, Admin and Member, so the free plan suffices. Rate limit is 1000 requests per minute per user. Private channels require the addon bot to be a member.
api_scope: Send messages, replies, deletions, reactions, create channels, list channel messages and the key creator's channels and DMs; full list in Swagger docs.

name: Discord
description: Discord REST API for bots and OAuth2 apps, with gateway events and webhooks.
gate_detail: Bot token is found on the Bot page in app settings, and OAuth2 client ID and secret on the OAuth2 page. Some scopes such as voice and rpc are limited to approved partners; Social SDK relationships.read needs a submission.
api_scope: REST API for Discord data, plus OAuth2 scopes for identity, guilds, webhooks and role connections; WebSocket gateway for real-time events.

name: Telegram
description: Telegram MTProto user and bot API; sources only detail user auth and the paid Gateway API.
gate_detail: Gateway access token is obtained in Gateway account settings, with per-message charges (free to your own number). How to obtain MTProto API credentials or bot tokens is not stated in the sources.
api_scope: MTProto user authorization via auth.sendCode with schema-defined methods; separate HTTP Gateway API for verification messages; Mini Apps init-data auth uses bot token HMAC.

name: WhatsApp Business
description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform: Cloud API for messaging and calling, plus management APIs.
gate_detail: Developers register, create a Meta app and generate a temporary test token. Permissions may need App Review submission, and partners onboard as Tech Providers. Messages are charged per delivery by category.
api_scope: Cloud API for messages and calls, Marketing Messages API, Business Management API, Groups API, templates and webhooks.

name: Aircall
description: Aircall public REST API and webhooks for calls, contacts, users, messaging and AI agents.
gate_detail: Public apps require a tech partner application and integration plan review (1 to 5 business days) before developer account and OAuth credentials issue. Private apps for your own workspace need no marketplace approval. Message sending needs Professional plan.
api_scope: REST API for calls, contacts, users, tags, webhooks, company, analytics exports, AI voice agent calls and messaging; webhooks for events; Embed SDK.

name: Vonage
description: Vonage offers communications APIs for messaging, voice, video, verification and network features.
gate_detail: Developers create a free account and get first API credentials from the dashboard. Pricing and any paid usage requirements are not described in the sources; no sandbox stated.
api_scope: Video, Voice, Messaging (including RCS and WhatsApp), Verify, Number Insight, Fraud Defender, network features and an Account API, with client and server SDKs.

name: Google Ads
description: Google Ads lets advertisers create and manage ads; the Google Ads API automates campaign management.
gate_detail: Production use needs a Google Cloud project with an API access level (Explorer, Basic or Standard); Standard goes through application review. API is free; Test access covers test accounts only.
api_scope: Programmatic management of Google Ads accounts, campaigns and reporting via the Google Ads API, with client libraries; also Google Ads scripts.

name: Meta Ads
description: Meta's Marketing API: Graph API endpoints for creating and managing ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp.
gate_detail: Limited access is granted automatically when adding the Marketing API product but is for development only; production use needs Full access through App Review.
api_scope: Graph API endpoints for campaigns, ad sets, creatives and insights, plus related Conversions, Catalog, Business Management and Commerce APIs; Meta Business SDK listed.

name: LinkedIn Ads
description: LinkedIn Marketing API program for campaign management, reporting, audiences, conversions and company insights.
gate_detail: Apply for Advertising API product on an app, with LinkedIn reviewing the application; Development tier first, Standard tier upgrade at LinkedIn's discretion. Some APIs need further approval.
api_scope: Ad campaigns and creatives, ad analytics, matched audiences, conversions, audience insights, media planning and company intelligence APIs.

name: GoHighLevel
description: GoHighLevel (HighLevel) is a CRM and marketing platform with a v3 API and an MCP server.
gate_detail: Sources describe the two auth types but not how to obtain a token, plan requirements or approvals. The OAuth page mentions a client_id and client_secret provided for your integration. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: v3 API covering CRM resources such as contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars and payments, with sub-account and company level access via OAuth tokens.

name: Mailchimp
description: Mailchimp offers a Marketing API for campaigns and a Transactional API (Mandrill) for event-driven email.
gate_detail: An API key for your own account is the fastest way to start; OAuth 2 is needed for third-party installs. Plan requirements and sandbox are not stated in the sources.
api_scope: Marketing API follows REST conventions on api.mailchimp.com/3.0 with OpenAPI descriptions and official client libraries; Transactional sends messages via API or SMTP.

name: Klaviyo
description: Klaviyo is a marketing platform with a public API, SDKs, OAuth and a hosted MCP server.
gate_detail: Private keys are created by the user in account Settings > API keys. Plan requirements are not stated; the Customer Agent beta API additionally requires Customer Agent to be enabled. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Versioned API with OpenAPI spec and SDKs; scoped resources such as profiles, lists, segments, metrics, subscriptions, reporting, plus a beta Customer Agent API using JSON:API conventions.

name: systeme.io
description: All-in-one marketing platform with funnels, email, courses and a public API plus MCP server.
gate_detail: Keys are created by the user under Settings > MCP & API keys. Sources state MCP access is on all plans including Free; the plan requirement for the public API itself is not stated. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Public API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, funnels, price plans, courses, automation rules, subscriptions, webhooks and digital products.

name: Pinterest
description: Pinterest developer platform API for content, ads, conversions and shopping catalogs.
gate_detail: Requires a business account, verified email and accepting developer terms to register an app. Test tokens need Trial access approval and expire after 24 hours. Sandbox exists for test calls.
api_scope: Manage organic Pins and Boards, ad campaigns and reporting, product catalogs and shopping ads, conversions and analytics.

name: Threads (Meta)
description: Threads API lets apps publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and read insights.
gate_detail: Create a Meta app with the Threads use case. Testers with a role can grant permissions immediately; other app users require each permission to pass App Review and the app to be published.
api_scope: Create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, mentions, insights, keyword search, webhooks and oEmbed.

name: SendGrid
description: Twilio SendGrid is a cloud email platform with a v3 Web API for transactional and marketing email.
gate_detail: API keys are created in the console after signup. Sources mention only a limited free trial option plus paid Email API and Marketing Campaigns plans; no permanent free plan is stated.
api_scope: Web REST API v3 at api.sendgrid.com covering email sending, templates and marketing campaigns, with SDKs in seven languages.

name: Shopify
description: Shopify is an ecommerce platform with GraphQL APIs for apps, stores and storefronts.
gate_detail: A free Shopify Partner account lets developers create apps and API keys. Public apps may face app review, which these sources do not detail.
api_scope: GraphQL Admin API, Storefront API, Partner API, Functions, Liquid and Shopify CLI covering the developer surfaces.

name: WooCommerce
description: WooCommerce store REST API integrated with WordPress REST API for store data.
gate_detail: API is per self-hosted store; the store admin enables the REST API and generates keys. No vendor approval or payment stated. Sandbox not described.
api_scope: CRUD over store data in JSON including coupons, customers, orders, products, taxes and webhooks, with bulk endpoints.

name: BigCommerce
description: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform with REST and GraphQL APIs for storefronts, apps and store data.
gate_detail: Developers sign up for a free trial sandbox store, then create API credentials in Settings > API Accounts. A live production store presumably needs a paid plan; sources do not state this.
api_scope: REST Management API, REST and GraphQL Storefront APIs, GraphQL Account and Admin APIs, Payments, Customer Login and Current Customer APIs.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers B2C and B2B commerce platforms with headless APIs, SDKs and CLI.
gate_detail: Requires a B2C Commerce instance and an Account Manager API client. Demo sandbox and on-demand sandbox exist. API is at no extra cost for B2C Commerce customers.
api_scope: SCAPI Shopper and Admin RESTful APIs, legacy OCAPI, Custom APIs, Node.js and React SDKs and a Commerce Cloud CLI.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
description: Adobe Commerce (Magento) is an extensible B2B/B2C commerce platform with REST and GraphQL web APIs.
gate_detail: Requires an Adobe Commerce instance where an admin registers an integration, or an Adobe Developer Console project for SaaS. Pricing and signup terms not stated.
api_scope: REST web APIs for PaaS and SaaS, GraphQL endpoint, event-driven integrations, App Builder and aio CLI tooling.

name: Squarespace
description: Squarespace offers Commerce and Reseller REST APIs, webhooks, custom code and an MCP server for developers.
gate_detail: API keys require the Commerce Advanced plan. OAuth requires registering an OAuth client that is reviewed and approved; listing in Extensions is a separate process. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Commerce APIs read and write orders, products, inventory, transactions, contacts and discounts; Reseller APIs provision sites and domains; Webhook Subscriptions API available via OAuth only.

name: Ecwid
description: Ecwid (Lightspeed) offers a REST API, webhooks and apps for managing store data.
gate_detail: After signing up and getting a custom app, secret and public tokens are available immediately. Public apps need App Market registration. A test store is suggested for development; plan requirements not stated.
api_scope: REST API to access and manage store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings, including orders, products, categories, customers and discounts.

name: Gumroad
description: Gumroad is a creator commerce platform with a REST API for products, sales, subscribers and licenses.
gate_detail: Create an application in Gumroad settings and generate an access token; no plan, scope selection or approval queue is described. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST API for products, variants, offer codes, custom fields, sales, subscribers, license keys, resource subscriptions (webhooks) and the authenticated user account.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
description: Amazon's Selling Partner API lets sellers and developers integrate with Amazon selling programmatically.
gate_detail: Requires a Professional Selling Account, a Solution Provider Portal account, and a data access request qualifying for specific roles after policy and security review. Private apps self-authorize; sandbox endpoints exist.
api_scope: Endpoints grouped under roles; use cases include inventory automation, product research, feedback management and keyword optimization for Amazon stores. API style is not stated in the sources.

name: fanbasis
description: FanBasis (now Commas) is a creator and enterprise payments platform with a REST API, SDKs and webhooks.
gate_detail: Enterprise API onboarding goes through a kickoff call with a dedicated implementation engineer that sets up API keys, webhooks and sandbox testing. No public self-serve key creation is shown.
api_scope: Payment orchestration, BNPL, subscriptions and multi-rail payouts via REST API with Node, Python, PHP and Ruby SDKs and a Postman collection.

name: DataForSEO
description: DataForSEO provides pay-as-you-go REST APIs for SERP, keyword, backlink and other SEO data.
gate_detail: Credentials come from the dashboard API Access page after signup. A free trial exists, but production use runs on pay-as-you-go pricing; the sources do not state trial limits or a minimum top-up.
api_scope: Covers SERP, keyword data, on-page, backlinks and other data APIs, with JSON responses, live and task-based methods, OpenAPI spec and official Python and TypeScript clients.

name: SE Ranking
description: SE Ranking offers a credit-based Data API and a Project API for SEO data and project automation.
gate_detail: A 14-day free trial gives 100K credits and an API key after email confirmation. Ongoing use needs a subscription plan, pay-as-you-go credit pack (from $50), API add-on or standalone plan.
api_scope: Data API for keyword, backlink, domain and audit data billed in credits, plus a Project API for managing sites, keywords and audits within subscription limits.

name: Ahrefs
description: Ahrefs offers a REST API, remote MCP server and connectors for its SEO and AI-visibility data.
gate_detail: API keys are created in the account's API keys report. Docs offer free test queries for trying endpoints without an Enterprise plan, implying production API access needs one. MCP use consumes subscription API units.
api_scope: REST API for keyword research, backlinks, rank tracking and AI-search brand visibility, with an OpenAPI spec, plus MCP, Data Studio connectors and a partner integration program.

name: MrScraper
description: MrScraper is a token-billed web scraping platform with a REST API, CLI, SDKs and MCP server.
gate_detail: Tokens are generated self-serve in the dashboard after sign-in. Usage draws on subscription-plan token allotments (e.g. Scraper Pro) billed via Stripe; the sources do not say whether a free tier or trial exists.
api_scope: Scraper API endpoints for HTML, Markdown, screenshot, brand and JSON extraction, web search, workflow and bulk scraping, analytics, and token and subscription verification.

name: Apify
description: Apify is a web scraping and automation platform with a REST API, official clients and an Actor marketplace.
gate_detail: A Free plan with $5 of prepaid usage needs no credit card; when it is used up the platform is blocked until the next cycle. Pay-as-you-go is only on paid plans. Full-permission Actors need one-time Console approval.
api_scope: Apify API for running Actors, storages and account resources, with official API clients for JavaScript, Python, Java and .NET, plus an SDK for building Actors.

name: Firecrawl
description: Firecrawl is a hosted web scraping, crawling, search and extraction API for AI agents.
gate_detail: Key is found in the Firecrawl dashboard; a Free plan exists with lower limits, and paid plans (Hobby to Scale) raise credits and concurrency. Keyless access to some endpoints with limits.
api_scope: Endpoints for scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, agent, interact browser sessions and Alexandria under api.firecrawl.dev; Python and Node SDK examples shown.

name: Bright Data
description: Web data platform offering proxies, scraper APIs, SERP API, Web Unlocker and datasets.
gate_detail: Every signup gets a free trial and a recurring 5,000 credits per month free tier. Personal-email accounts without a payment method are restricted from Proxy Networks and Web Unlocker until a no-charge verification payment method is added.
api_scope: REST APIs for Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, Browser API and datasets, plus Account Management API (e.g. pricing plans); docs also reference a CLI.

name: Sherlock
description: Sherlock-project is a GitHub repository; sources give no developer API information for it.
gate_detail: Sources do not establish any hosted first-party API or credential path for sherlock-project; unrelated products named Sherlock appear in other sources.
api_scope: No first-party public API is documented in the sources for sherlock-project.

name: Waterfall.io
description: GTM enrichment API aggregating 30+ data vendors for contacts, emails, phones and job changes.
gate_detail: API key is requested via the Get API access page and the team reviews every access request. Pricing is quoted after a benchmark on your data; no public rate card.
api_scope: Prospector, contact, phone and company enrichment, email verification, job changes, website company identification, usage tracking and account reporting.

name: Clay
description: GTM data enrichment and workflow platform with API keys, a CLI and an MCP integration.
gate_detail: A Clay account is needed to create a key. A Free plan (500 actions/mo) and 14-day trial exist; webhook automation and HTTP API integration are listed on higher plans. Public API breadth is not documented in sources.
api_scope: Documented API key is for Clay-native integrations such as looking up rows in other tables; a clay CLI exists. No full public REST reference appears in sources.

name: GitHub
description: Developer platform whose REST API covers repositories, issues, actions, organizations and more.
gate_detail: Any GitHub user can authenticate with tokens or create apps in Developer settings. Some endpoints (enterprise, billing, paid features) follow plan or admin requirements. No sandbox described.
api_scope: REST API described by an OpenAPI document, covering many areas including billing usage, budgets, CI status and app integrations; gh api CLI can call it.

name: Vercel
description: Vercel REST API for deploying web apps, managing projects, domains, environment variables and teams.
gate_detail: Developers create Access Tokens in account settings; no plan requirement is stated. Read-only or scoped tokens are reportedly unavailable (community thread), so tokens are full-account. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: HTTP REST API under api.vercel.com covering deployments, domains, projects, environment variables, teams, webhooks, storage, sandboxes and many other categories; SDK also mentioned.

name: Netlify
description: Netlify REST API for managing sites, atomic deploys, forms, DNS and snippets.
gate_detail: Developers generate a personal access token in Applications settings, or register an OAuth application in user settings. No plan restriction on API access is stated; SSO teams need explicit token grant. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST API at api.netlify.com/api/v1 to manage atomic deploys, form submissions, JavaScript snippets, DNS and sites.

name: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare API for managing accounts, zones, tokens and other Cloudflare services, with SDKs and Terraform provider.
gate_detail: Developers create an API token themselves; no plan requirement is stated for token creation. Some endpoints (e.g. Organizations read/update/delete) need a Global API key. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST API with account, token, audit log and billing endpoints plus TypeScript, Python and Go libraries and a Terraform provider.

name: Supabase
description: Supabase Data REST API and Management API for Postgres-backed projects, plus an official MCP server.
gate_detail: Developers get project API keys from dashboard settings and a Management API access token from account tokens page. No plan requirement stated for these; some MCP branching tools need a paid plan. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Auto-generated PostgREST REST API over each project's database, a Management API for organizations and projects, a GraphQL API listed in docs, and client libraries.

name: Neo4j
description: Neo4j Aura management API plus database drivers for querying and managing graph databases.
gate_detail: All Aura tiers can create API credentials. AuraDB Free costs $0 with no payment method required, so a free account suffices; paid tiers are for production scale.
api_scope: Aura API for managing cloud instances authenticated with OAuth 2.0, and language drivers (e.g. Python) for running queries against a database.

name: Snowflake
description: Snowflake data platform with REST APIs, SQL API and drivers for managing and querying data.
gate_detail: Sources only show a Getting a Trial Account path; a Snowflake account is needed for any credentials. Whether a permanent free plan exists is not stated. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Snowflake REST APIs (e.g. databases under /api/v2), a SQL API, a Catalog SDK, plus connectors, drivers and the Snowflake CLI.

name: MongoDB Atlas
description: MongoDB Atlas Administration API for managing Atlas clusters, projects and organizations programmatically.
gate_detail: Atlas offers a free-forever M0 tier; credentials are created in an organization or project by users with suitable access roles. Whether the Admin API works on the free tier is not stated.
api_scope: Atlas Administration API for administrative tasks outside the Atlas UI, plus Go SDK, Atlas CLI, Terraform provider and other tooling.

name: Datadog
description: Datadog observability platform with an HTTP REST API covering monitors, logs, metrics, dashboards and more.
gate_detail: Keys are created within a Datadog organization and require user permissions; sources shown do not state whether a free plan or trial suffices to obtain them.
api_scope: Described as a way to access the Datadog platform programmatically, with many resource groups and official client libraries for Java, Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript and Rust.

name: Sentry
description: Sentry offers a web API for managing organizations, teams and exporting error-monitoring data.
gate_detail: Provided text shows an authentication-token tutorial but not plan requirements or approval steps. Account signup exists at sentry.io/signup, but its terms for API tokens are not stated.
api_scope: Web API (v0) to manage account-level resources like organizations and teams, and manage and export data; reference covers many resource groups including events, projects, releases, SCIM.

name: Notion
description: Notion API for reading and writing pages, databases, comments and users in workspaces.
gate_detail: Tokens and OAuth integrations are created in the Developer portal; a free Notion plan exists. The Admin API is Enterprise-only and some agent features are in private beta.
api_scope: REST API for pages, databases, comments, content queries and users, with an official JavaScript SDK and the ntn CLI.

name: Airtable
description: Airtable Web API for reading and writing bases, tables and records, with webhooks and MCP.
gate_detail: Personal access tokens are available on all plan types and are created by users themselves; OAuth integrations are registered at /create/oauth. Enterprise admins can limit token lifetime or allowlist MCP integrations.
api_scope: Web API for bases and records with scopes and per-base access, plus webhooks and an MCP server for AI tools.

name: Linear
description: Linear GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK for issues, projects and agents, with OAuth and webhooks.
gate_detail: Linear has a free plan plus paid plans; OAuth applications are created by workspace admins, and creating a dedicated workspace for the OAuth app is recommended. Free-plan API limits are not stated.
api_scope: GraphQL API with pagination, filtering, webhooks, attachments and customers, plus a TypeScript SDK and agent interaction docs.

name: Jira
description: Jira is Atlassian's issue and project tracker with REST APIs for cloud and Data Center.
gate_detail: Developers generate an API token from their own Atlassian account and use it with email via basic auth. REST API access is free on all Jira plans, so a Jira site is needed. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST APIs for Jira Cloud and Jira Data Center (Software), accessed via site URLs or api.atlassian.com with cloudId for scoped tokens.

name: Asana
description: Asana's developer platform offers a RESTful API, webhooks and app components for work-management automation.
gate_detail: PATs are generated in the developer console and suffice for single-user apps; OAuth for multi-user apps. Service Accounts (needed for audit log, SCIM, exports) are Enterprise-only and super-admin created. Free-plan status not stated.
api_scope: RESTful JSON API for much of Asana's data, plus webhooks, app components, Audit Log API, SCIM and organizational exports.

name: Monday.com
description: monday.com's developer platform offers a GraphQL platform API, apps framework, webhooks and a hosted MCP server.
gate_detail: A free developer account gives an API token for testing; personal tokens mirror the user's UI permissions. Dynamic MCP connectors need admin approval.
api_scope: GraphQL platform API for workflows and data, plus apps with UI extensions, hosting, webhooks and agents.

name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp is a work-management platform with a public API, webhooks, OAuth and an MCP server.
gate_detail: Public API is available on all plans, and a personal token is generated in account settings. Creating OAuth apps needs a Workspace owner or admin. Some user and guest endpoints are Enterprise-only. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Public API covering Workspace data, with an API spec, OAuth, webhooks and an MCP server; some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan.

name: Coda
description: Coda (now Superhuman Docs) is a doc and table platform with a REST API and MCP server.
gate_detail: Sources do not say how to obtain API credentials or whether a free plan suffices. A section titled Free and Paid Workspaces exists but its content is not shown. Developer Terms require review of Offerings before release to end users.
api_scope: List and search docs, create and copy docs, share and publish them, discover pages, tables, formulas and controls, and read, insert, upsert, update and delete rows.

name: Smartsheet
description: Smartsheet is a work-management platform with a REST API and SDKs for sheets and workspaces.
gate_detail: Generating an API access token requires a Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plan. No free tier or sandbox is described in the sources.
api_scope: REST operations over sheets and workspaces, browsable and callable in the docs site, with official Python, Java, C# and JavaScript SDKs.

name: Harvest
description: Harvest is a time-tracking and invoicing product with a v2 REST-style API and Forecast API.
gate_detail: Personal Access Tokens can be generated through a Harvest ID account. Plan requirements are not stated and no sandbox is described.
api_scope: Resources include clients, invoices, estimates, expenses, tasks, time entries, projects, users, reports, approvals, time off, imports, notifications and the Forecast API.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe is a payments platform with a REST API for payments, billing, Connect and more.
gate_detail: Developers view and manage API keys in the Stripe Dashboard after creating an account. Test mode secret keys give sandbox access; live mode uses restricted or secret keys. Free signup cost not explicitly stated.
api_scope: REST API at api.stripe.com with form-encoded requests and JSON responses covering core resources, billing, Connect, Issuing, Terminal, Tax, Identity and more; official client libraries.

name: Plaid
description: Plaid financial data API for bank account linking, balances, identity, transactions and payments.
gate_detail: Sandbox is always free with test Items. Production access must be requested via the Dashboard; a free Trial (US/Canada, new teams) allows 10 Production Items; EU/UK customers only get Custom plans.
api_scope: Endpoints and webhooks across products such as Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities and Enrich; Node SDK shown.

name: Binance
description: Binance cryptocurrency exchange API for market data, trading and account management using API keys.
gate_detail: Per a third-party catalog, API access is free to authenticated users. Keys are created in account API Management; a testnet is mentioned for development. Higher VIP tiers raise request limits.
api_scope: Market data, WebSocket streams, and trading and account operations via the exchange API, per third-party descriptions; first-party docs not included.

name: Paygent Connect
description: Sources describe Paygent, an AI-agent billing product, not the NMI-powered Paygent Connect payments gateway.
gate_detail: Sources cover the wrong product. That product has a free tier with no credit card required, but this says nothing about Paygent Connect (NMI) access.
api_scope: Sources describe a REST API for plans, users and subscriptions of an AI usage-billing product, not payment gateway APIs.

name: iPayX
description: iPayX is an FX forensic audit service with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server.
gate_detail: Dashboard signup issues a production API key, but pricing lists API plans from $99/mo; free tier is 3 lifetime audits. Unclear whether free users get API keys. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST endpoints for live mid-market rates, FX audits and batch document audits, plus audit.completed webhooks and an MCP server.

name: QuickBooks
description: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud accounting platform with a REST Accounting API.
gate_detail: Free Intuit developer account; Builder tier has no platform service fees. Per-developer sandbox companies provided. Paid Silver/Gold/Platinum tiers apply for higher volumes.
api_scope: REST Accounting API for customers, invoices, payments, bills, vendors, accounts and journal entries; separate Payments API; Intuit SDKs and OAuth libraries.

name: Xero
description: Xero is cloud accounting software with a developer platform offering OAuth 2.0 APIs, SDKs and an MCP server.
gate_detail: Free developer account and Starter app plan at no charge, limited to 5 connections. Core and higher plans require app certification and a credit card.
api_scope: Accounting and related APIs with SDKs; advanced plan adds Journals endpoint, Practice Manager API and Bulk Connections.

name: Brex
description: Brex is a spend platform with REST APIs for cards, expenses, payments, teams and travel.
gate_detail: Quickstart assumes a Brex customer with admin access who creates a user token in dashboard Settings > Developer. MCP also needs an admin to accept the Developer API agreement. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Ten API groups including Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel and Webhooks, defined with OpenAPI.

name: Ramp
description: Ramp is a finance platform with a developer API documented at docs.ramp.com.
gate_detail: Sources contain only JavaScript-shell pages, so how a developer obtains credentials, and any plan, approval or sales gate, is not established.
api_scope: Sources only point to an OpenAPI spec and API reference files, implying a documented developer API; no scope details are given.

name: PitchBook
description: PitchBook offers private-market company, deal, investor and fund data through a contract-based REST API.
gate_detail: No developer signup or key button; access goes through the Direct Data team under a separate contract. Credentials arrive after signing; a sandbox exists only once in the process.
api_scope: OpenAPI-defined APIs for account information, companies, credit analysis, deals, fundamentals, funds, investors, limited partners, patents, people and service providers.

name: NotebookLM
description: NotebookLM Enterprise API manages notebooks via Google Cloud's Discovery Engine REST endpoints; Pre-GA.
gate_detail: Requires a Google Cloud project with organization identity provider configured and an admin (project owner or Cloud NotebookLM Admin) setting up the product. API is Pre-GA with limited support.
api_scope: REST methods under v1alpha for notebooks, such as retrieving and listing recently viewed notebooks, and adding sources.

name: Otter AI
description: Otter.ai offers an API, webhooks and an MCP server, but the sources document no developer API details.
gate_detail: The pricing page lists Otter API and Webhooks under the Enterprise plan, which is custom priced with a demo request. Free Basic plan lists an Otter MCP server.
api_scope: Not documented in the sources; pricing page only lists Otter API and Webhooks as an Enterprise feature.

name: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant with a developer API, SDKs and an official MCP server.
gate_detail: Sources do not state how to obtain an API key or any plan requirement for the Fathom meeting product. The Fathom Analytics source is a different product and was ignored.
api_scope: Developer docs list API docs, API reference and TypeScript and Python SDKs for meeting data; endpoints are not detailed in the sources.

name: Consensus
description: Consensus offers an API for peer-reviewed research search and cited analysis.
gate_detail: Public page shows a Create API key button, but an aggregator says enterprise/API access must be requested via a request-access flow. Access path is conflicting, so the stronger prerequisite is assumed.
api_scope: Quick search of papers returning metadata and full-text excerpts, plus an asynchronous Threads endpoint for cited research-agent answers with grounding quotes.

name: Reducto
description: Reducto is a document processing API for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying and editing files.
gate_detail: Free account signup in the docs; Standard plan includes $150 in free usage, then pay-as-you-go. Enterprise features such as VPC, BAA and custom SLA need higher tiers. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Endpoints for parse, extract, split, classify and edit across 30+ file types, with Python, Node.js and Go SDKs, a CLI and Studio.

name: Devin
description: Devin is Cognition's AI software engineer, with a v3 API for sessions, knowledge and playbooks.
gate_detail: Keys are provisioned in Settings > Devin API by creating a service user with an RBAC role. Required plan or admin rights are not stated; enterprise PATs need admin policy and approval.
api_scope: v3 organization and enterprise endpoints covering session management, knowledge, playbooks and secrets, plus enterprise analytics, audit logs and billing.

name: higgsfield
description: Higgsfield API generates images and video from code using one API key and a prepaid dollar balance.
gate_detail: Sign up, register a payment method and fund a prepaid USD balance before requests run; no plan or subscription involved. No free tier or sandbox stated.
api_scope: Asynchronous image and video generation across the model catalog, with request status polling, webhooks, a cost estimate endpoint and Python and TypeScript SDKs.

name: Mermaid CLI
description: Mermaid CLI is a local command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagrams, not a hosted API.
gate_detail: Install and run locally with no account or credentials. There is no hosted first-party API to obtain credentials for.
api_scope: Local diagram rendering through the mmdc command line and a Node.js API that is not covered by semver; no hosted endpoints.

name: YouTube Transcript
description: TranscriptAPI provides REST endpoints for YouTube transcripts, search, channel and playlist data, plus an MCP server.
gate_detail: Keys come from the account dashboard without any stated approval. Most endpoints consume credits per call, while info and latest-videos endpoints are free; free signup credits and plan prices are not stated.
api_scope: Transcript extraction, video info and metadata, YouTube search, channel videos, posts and sections, and playlist videos, with a Swagger UI for interactive testing.

name: Grain
description: Grain public API reads and manages meeting recordings, highlights and uploads, with webhooks and an official MCP server.
gate_detail: Personal access tokens are available on every plan including Free. Workspace tokens for server-side workspace-wide access need an admin on Business or Enterprise. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Read and manage recordings, highlights, tags and sharing, upload external recordings, download video and transcripts in several formats, and receive webhooks when recordings are processed.
